about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience building scalable web applications and digital platforms. Currently at Darkcam S.A, I architect end-to-end solutions that integrate AI-assisted development workflows with cloud-native infrastructure.
about.p2: My approach combines robust backend engineering with polished frontend experiences, leveraging tools like Claude AI and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development while maintaining high code quality. I specialize in transforming complex business requirements into intuitive, performant products.
about.p3: Based in Quito, Ecuador with a Master's in Information Technology from the University of Wollongong, I bring both academic rigor and hands-on pragmatism to every project.

items.description: Leading development of AI-augmented web platforms using Next.js, TypeScript, and AWS. Architecting microservices with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Delivered 10+ production projects for clients across automotive, logistics, and identity verification sectors. Specialized in React, Node.js, and cloud deployments.
Enterprise-level technical support and infrastructure troubleshooting. Developed automation scripts and improved incident response processes.
Systems administration, network troubleshooting, and end-user support. Built foundations in infrastructure and problem-solving.
